artworks.title: Johannes Utenbogaert
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated and facing slightly to the right while making eye contact with the viewer. He has a short, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and closely cropped hair. He is wearing a formal garment with a high, pleated ruff collar and a fur-trimmed cloak. The background has an ornate oval frame decorated with elaborate scrollwork and the inscription "IOHANNES U TENN BOGAERT" along with additional text around the edge. The artwork suggests a historical context with decorative elements typical of portrait engravings, such as the intricate border and stylized frame details.

artworks.title: Johannes Uytenbogaert
artworks.description: The image depicts Johannes Utenbogaert's upper body. He is facing slightly to the right, looking at the viewer. He has a prominent mustache, wavey hair, a receding hairline, and a serious expression. He wears a textured ruff around his neck, typical of his era's attire. His clothing is formal and dark. In the background, there is a subtle lined pattern. Text at the bottom includes his name and some additional writing.

artworks.title: Johann Valentin Maier
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of an older man with distinct features, including deep-set eyes and long, gray wavy hair. He is wearing a dark cap and a dark garment with a wide white collar. The oval frame surrounding the portrait is decorated with Latin script, and there is a smaller crest below with an illustration and text. The background consists of dense hatch marks typical of engraving.

artworks.title: Marguerite de Valois, Wife of Henry of Navarre
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is facing slightly to her left with a serene expression. Her hair is styled in tight curls and she is wearing a richly decorated dress with jewelry. The background features ornate French text encircling the portrait, reading "MARGVERITE DE VALOIS ROYNE DE NAVARRE."

artworks.title: Marguerite de Valois, Wife of Henry of Navarre
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman from the upper half of her body. She is depicted in a forward-facing, slightly turned position, showcasing her detailed attire. The woman has distinct facial features, including high cheekbones, a delicate nose, and pursed lips. Her hair is styled in an updo with an elaborate headpiece featuring a decorative jewel. She wears a historical gown with an intricate pattern, pearls or jewels on the neckline and bodice, a choker-style necklace made of beads, and a high collar. The background is shaded with lines, and the portrait is framed in an oval with inscriptions stating "Margarita Valois" and "1589."

artworks.title: Barbara van Beck
artworks.description: The image presents an engraved portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is situated with her body facing slightly to the viewer's left, with her arms resting in front of her on a stringed musical instrument. The woman has a full face of hair, including a beard, wavy hair that extends beyond her shoulders, and wears a garment with large sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a wide collar adorned with a decorative bow. She is seated in front of a musical instrument resembling a zither or dulcimer on a table. The background features detailed lines for texture, and the bottom of the image includes a block of text in a foreign script.

artworks.title: Barbara van Beck, A Bearded Lady
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a person standing behind a zither on a table with a cloth. The person has long hair and a beard, wearing a dress with intricate details. A dog with a collar is present on the left. Background elements include a railing, balusters, columns, and an inscription above the person's head.

artworks.title: Richard Vaughan, Bishop of London
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing forward, with distinct features including a nose, cheekbones, and a full beard. He wears a hat with a rounded crown typical of the Renaissance period, along with textured clothing and an undergarment with intricate patterns near the collar. The background is detailed with crosshatching. Text at the bottom likely identifies the individual as Ricardus Vaughanus in Latin.

artworks.title: Francis le Mothe le Vayer
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man facing slightly left. His head is turned towards the front, showing his facial features. The man has a smooth expression with large, almond-shaped eyes, a high forehead, and long, wavy hair falling past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark garment with a white collar, typical of 17th-century fashion. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame within a larger rectangular frame, with patterns in the background. Below the image is an inscription in Latin introducing the man as "Franciscus Mothaeus Vayerius" with his titles. The image has a monochrome appearance resembling an engraved print.

artworks.title: Octavio van Veen
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting upright, looking slightly towards the right. He has short, wavy hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and mustache. He is wearing formal historical attire with a ruffled collar, a cap, and a cloak or robe with a satiny texture. His right hand is resting on a closed book on a table. The background has a textured crosshatch pattern. Text is visible in the lower portion of the image.

artworks.title: Theodore Veit, Preacher
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut print of a man portrayed in profile from the waist up, facing left. He is seated and holding a book. The man has distinct facial features, short combed-back hair, and wears a high-collared coat with a cloth tied around his neck. The background includes a leafy plant on the left and an architectural element or book-like object. On the right, there is an arched stone feature. Old German text is present at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Horace Vere, Baron Vere of Tilbury
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse, holding a baton or staff. He wears armor with a draped fabric, a hat, and a coat of arms. The background includes fields, trees, and a building or castle, with figures in tents.

artworks.title: M. Francois Veron, Doctor of Theology, Lecturer, Professor, under Louis XIV
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the chest up, facing slightly to his left with a composed expression. He has short, wavy hair, a cap, and a furrowed brow. The man has a full beard and mustache, dressed in a garment with a fur-lined collar. In the background, there is a scene of a lecture or sermon. The portrait is framed by an oval border with inscriptions. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held by the man.

artworks.title: Pietro Antonio Tolentino
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a serious expression. The individual is depicted from the upper body up, facing slightly to the right. They have defined facial features, including a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a neatly trimmed beard. The person's short hair is combed close to the scalp. They are wearing a garment with a fur-trimmed collar over possibly buttoned attire. The portrait is framed within an ornate oval border, part of a larger decorative stone-like framework. Above the oval, there is a carved face resembling a cherub, and below it, another carved face resembling a man's. The background features intricate line work and hatching, enhancing the architectural details.

artworks.title: Amerigo Vespucci
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a profile view of a man's upper body and head facing to the right. The man has a prominent nose, rounded chin, slightly pronounced lips, curly short hair covered by a turban-like headpiece, and is wearing a high-collared coat. The image is framed in an ornate oval border with Latin inscriptions. In the top left corner, there is a bird on a branch, and in the bottom left corner, a figure with feathered headdress extends an arm. The right side of the frame features decorative elements. The background is textured with detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Victor Amedeo I, Duke of Savoy
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to the right. He has a mustache, wavy hair styled back, and refined facial features with a composed expression. The man wears ornate armor with a lace collar, typical of aristocratic attire. The portrait is framed by intricate scrollwork with a lightly textured wall in the background. Below the portrait is an inscription identifying the subject as Victor Amédée, Duc de Savoie et Prince de Piémont, with the artist's signature "Martelle excudit."

artworks.title: Johann Volckamer
artworks.description: This image shows an elderly man in an upper-body portrait with facial features including deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, a long beard, and wavy, grey hair. He wears a dark, formal garment with a white collar. In his hands, he holds a small bouquet of flowers and a scroll. The frame around the portrait is decorated with floral designs and cherubic figures, with a crest at the top center. A plaque with text is below the portrait.

artworks.title: Everardus Vorstius Medicinae
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is facing the viewer with his head turned to his left. He has a beard, mustache, neatly groomed hair, and is wearing a detailed garment with a large ruff collar. In the background, there is a textured oval design, and the portrait is bordered by a rectangular frame with a label at the bottom that reads "EVERARDUS VORSTIUS MEDICINÆ PROF. & MAGNIF. RECTOR." The image is monochrome.

artworks.title: Martin de Vos
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Joseph Heintz the Elder
artworks.description: This is a detailed engraving featuring a portrait of a man shown from the shoulders up. The man is positioned in a three-quarter view, gazing towards the viewer or slightly to the side, with his head slightly tilted downwards. He has a round, full beard and curly hair tinged with gray. His expression is calm and dignified. He wears ornate clothing with a fur-trimmed collar and a richly decorated patterned garment underneath. The portrait is set within an oval frame, surrounded by classical architectural elements and flanked by two allegorical female figures. The woman on the left is dressed in a helmet and armor, while the woman on the right carries a caduceus. Above the man's head is a crest with an animal and a Latin inscription. The background is an intricately detailed architectural setting reminiscent of a grand hall or temple.

artworks.title: Martin de Vos
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Joseph Heintz the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man framed within an oval. He faces forward with a slight head turn to the right, making direct eye contact with the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with a full, curly beard, mustache, and hair. He wears a garment with a high collar lined with fur. Surrounding him are ornate architectural elements, including two partial figures of allegorical women on either side. The background features classical columns and a decorated arch with an emblem showing a lamb and the Latin phrase "SPIRAVIT ET EXARDE". The overall aesthetic is detailed and sophisticated.

artworks.title: Albrecht Wenzel Euscbius von Wallenstein
artworks.description: This is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is positioned facing slightly to the left, with his head turned to look at the viewer. He has an oval face with a prominent mustache, a high forehead, and his hair is short and slicked back, appearing dark in color. The man is dressed in armor with a prominent, wide collar typical of the 17th-century style, and he wears a decorative sash over one shoulder. His right hand is holding a baton or staff, which extends across the lower section of the image. The background is plain with a lined texture, and the portrait is set within an oval frame that contains inscribed text. The outer area of the image also contains additional text beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir William Waller, Parliamentary General
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting a man's head, shoulders, and upper chest. The man has long, wavy hair and a mustache and goatee. He is facing slightly to the left with a stern expression. He is dressed in period attire with a high-collared shirt, a brooch, and a draped garment. The background is plain with an oval frame around the portrait. Below the image is a text inscription stating "William Waller" and his title and role.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Walsingham
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man facing slightly to his right. He has short hair with a receding hairline, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing an ornate garment with a ruffled ruff around his neck, fur trim on the collar and shoulders, and a textured pattern on the sleeves. The man is set within an oval frame with the text "FRANCIS MUNSINGHA". The background outside the oval consists of fine, parallel lines. The portrait is on a plain page with slightly torn and worn edges, giving it an antique appearance.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Walsingham
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image displays a man with a pointed beard and mustache, wearing formal attire with a high-collared garment and an elaborate ruffled collar. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, within an oval frame with detailed linear patterns. Latin text is present above and below the frame.
